title: Thenkasi Pattanam
desc: Kannan and Dass become feared rowdies under the guidance of their godfather. But two women, Meenakshi and Sangeetha bring forth a whirlwind of events in their lives.

title: Pudhu Nilavu
desc: Madan breaks his friendship with Anand because the latter likes the same girl he does. However, Madan is extremely shocked when he makes a discovery about Anand.

title: Vetri Vizha
desc: A man suffers from amnesia after an accident and tries to get his life back together. However, things take a turn when he starts remembering his past.

title: Jore
desc: Sakthi falls in love with the daughter of a corrupt politician and later competes with her brother, Vijay, at the college election. Things escalate when Vijay loses and his father gets furious.

title: Raajiyam
desc: Karthikeyan runs a secret agency. When he proves that the governor's son has killed his own wife, the leader hatches a plan to exact revenge.
